about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS DEMO

Requital is the story of how far a lover can go—or how far they can fall. A relentless chase, an epic love story, and pulse-pounding rhythms come together in this physical action-rhythm game. From the wild west to ruined wastelands, from post-apocalyptic realms to cities of the risen dead—wield your weapons and chase vengeance across time.

Dodge, duck, and destroy. First conquer your enemies, then master the music.

Requital Demo offers a glimpse of what awaits in the full game. In this scene, set in a classic Western shootout:

  • Experience the core gameplay mechanics

  • Learn combat survival tips during rhythm-based battles

  • Play 2 of the 70 unique tracks that await in the full version

  • Step into a Western-themed map—one of 21 different time periods.

See you in the full version for even more rhythm, fire, fury and revenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 970 or equivalent
  • Sound Card: Required
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Oculus Pc Vr, Quest 1-2-3-Pro, Standing or Sitting
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 or greater
  • Sound Card: Required
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended

short_description: Requital is a fast-paced, rhythm-based VR shooter where precision define survival. Travel through past and future timelines, eliminating enemies in music-driven combat encounters. Each level is handcrafted to sync perfectly with intense, pulse-pounding soundtracks. Move, shoot and stay on beat.
